name: frost-shard-graveyard-activation-affordable-still-activates
notes: Positive pin: the same graveyard activation of Frost Shard with two payers in hand activates for two reserve payments, deals its 2 damage to the opposing champion and is banished as it resolves.

rulesClauses: [Class Bonus] If you leveled up this turn, you may activate Frost Shard from your graveyard; banish it as it resolves.
